title:
Fine-tuning
a legal AI system
with genetic algorithms:
A pragmatic approach
lead:
Discover how we transformed Animo’s legal research process with cutting-edge AI technology. In this whitepaper, we take you behind the scenes of our technical journey—unveiling how advanced machine learning, genetic algorithms and large language models were combined to create a powerful AI-driven legal assistant.

Whether you’re in legal, finance, healthcare or any other sector, this whitepaper shows how scalable AI solutions can optimize search, improve accuracy and transform decision-making.

Curious to know how it’s done? Download the whitepaper and unlock the tech behind AI-driven efficiency!

Need a general whitepaper that compares generative AI with classical machine learning? Click here.
